note: Licences for the Rust crates in apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock, which link into the shipped binary and so fall under ADR-0006 exactly as node_modules does. The licence gate runs before the Rust build in CI, where the cargo registry cache is empty and nothing may be fetched, so every crate is recorded here. Each licence below was read on a developer machine from the [package].license field of that crate's own Cargo.toml as cargo unpacked it into the local registry cache, at the path given in `source`; no value here was guessed or looked up over the network. Where the cache is populated the gate re-reads it and fails if a record disagrees, so a stale entry is loud rather than silent. Records are keyed name@version, so a version bump is re-audited rather than inheriting the licence of the version before it. A Cargo.lock crate matching nothing here and absent from the cache fails the gate.
